input: Source fabric to make reusable produce bags

gold.taskTitle: Source fabric for reusable produce bags
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase suitable fabric to make homemade reusable produce bags.

questions.title: How many produce bags do you plan to make?
questions.description: Understanding the quantity will determine how much fabric needs to be sourced.

questions.title: What fabric type are you considering for the bags?
questions.description: For example, mesh, muslin, cotton voile, or ripstop nylon — each has different properties and sources.

questions.title: What size bags do you need to make?
questions.description: Produce bags vary from small herb-sized to large for bulky vegetables; size affects yardage needed.

questions.title: Do you have a budget per yard or overall in mind?
questions.description: A budget will narrow down whether to shop at a fabric store, online retailer, or wholesale supplier.

questions.title: Do you prefer to shop locally or order fabric online?
questions.description: This determines whether to search nearby fabric or craft stores versus online marketplaces.

questions.title: Is the fabric required to be certified organic or food-safe?
questions.description: Some people want GOTS-certified or chemical-free fabric since the bags contact fresh produce directly.

questions.title: When do you need the fabric ready to use by?
questions.description: A deadline will influence whether standard shipping, expedited delivery, or a local purchase is more appropriate.
